response.sql:
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes t
  GROUP BY t.observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_avg
  FROM station_avg
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusage,
       s.avg_bandusage - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall
FROM station_avg s
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE s.avg_bandusage > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: AVG ignores NULL bandusagepct values, so a station whose telescopes all have NULL bandusage gets a NULL average, is left out of the overall mean, and never passes the above-average filter.

Stations are taken from telescopes.observstation, which is a foreign key to observatories.observstation, so the station set is the same as joining observatories. Stations with no telescopes have no average and do not appear.
